verdict.rationale: Kling AI is a generative video and image platform. An in-product AI assistant that offers suggestions is a fair axis for it, so the story applies. The only related evidence is an Agent you can brainstorm with and that writes scripts (kling-docs-3), which is creative ideation, not insights or suggestions derived from the user's own data. No evidence shows any data-driven insight feature, so this adjacent feature earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
